name: Italy
gaps: LIPU has approximately 100 local sections across Italy. This list includes sections with verified websites; most smaller delegations lack standalone websites but operate through the main LIPU organization. Additional independent ornithological societies exist (S.O.I., SROPU, ASOIM) but are specialized research organizations.

LIPU Vibo (Calabria, Vibo Valentia): the delegazione's domain has lapsed and is now a for sale parking page, and no Facebook page of its own was findable, so it was dropped rather than published broken.

Basilicata: no independent birding club, LIPU delegazione or ornithological society with its own website or Facebook page was found. The region is only covered by LIPU's joint Puglia e Basilicata coordination based in Foggia, so no standalone card is honest here.

Umbria: Centro Studi Ornitologici Antonio Valli da Todi has a website but its most recent post is from 2020, so it reads as dormant rather than active and was left out. No other Umbria specific birding group was found.
Valle d'Aosta: LIPU only opened a delegazione there in January 2026, presented publicly on 16 January, and it has no website or Facebook page of its own yet, only a contact email through lipu.it.

name: New Zealand
gaps: The New Zealand Bird Atlas is run through eBird's atlasnz portal, so as a global platform page it is not listed here even though it is the count NZ birders actually use.

Birds New Zealand also has branches in a few more areas without their own findable page yet: Far North, South Auckland, Whanganui and Wairarapa, each reachable from the society's own find your region page.

name: Canada
gaps: Nunavut: no birding club, naturalist society or public social media group was found. The historic NWT/Nunavut Bird Checklist Survey folded into eBird Canada in 2012 so it is no longer its own community, and the Nunavut Wildlife Management Board's Community Based Monitoring Network is a general wildlife harvest programme for Inuit harvesters, not a joinable birding community.
